SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Show Login Prompt

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Don't implement renewSSO()
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: When ON, the sample-app does not implement renewSSO(), so the SDK has to handle SSO renewal itself. When OFF, the sample-app implements it and the SDK uses it.
